results.title: Sources qualifying on three legs

steps.title: Given a completed analysis with visibility, competitive, and negative concept answers each citing at least one source
When the Actions Center is opened and the Target Sources list renders
Then sources cited in visibility gap answers appear in the list (AMELIORER LA VISIBILITE tab: 192 sources confirmed)
And sources cited in competitive/negative concept answers appear in the list (AMELIORER LA PERCEPTION tab: 29 sources confirmed)

results.notes: VISIBILITE tab: 192 sources (10 visible + 182 more). PERCEPTION tab: 29 sources (10 visible + 19 more). Sources with both badges (frandroid.com, kbb.com, caranddriver.com, evupdatemedia.us, cargurus.com, numerama.com). PARTIAL: UI does not distinguish between 'competitive loss' (leg 2) and 'negative concept' (leg 3) — both map to single AMELIORER LA PERCEPTION badge. Three separate qualifying legs cannot be individually verified via UI.

results.title: Brand ranked but not first does not qualify

steps.title: Given a completed analysis where a source is cited only in visibility answers where the brand is present but ranked 2nd or lower
When the Actions Center is opened and Target Sources list renders
Then the source cited only in those non-qualifying visibility answers does not appear in the Target Sources list

results.notes: SKIP — Backend-only precondition. Requires specific data state where a source is cited EXCLUSIVELY in visibility answers where Toyota appears ranked 2nd or lower. This precondition cannot be controlled or verified via UI. The qualifying/exclusion logic is applied server-side at query time; the UI provides no visibility into per-answer rank data per source.

results.title: Articles recorded with the source

steps.title: Given a completed analysis exists and frandroid.com (#1 source) appears in the Target Sources list
When the explanation panel is opened for frandroid.com
Then the failing articles displayed in the panel include specific article URLs matching the qualifying answers for this source

results.notes: Panel opened for frandroid.com (#1 in TOUTES tab). Panel shows: 28 articles problematiques, 8 positif(s), cited 116 times in unfavorable answers. 10 articles visible with full specific URLs (e.g. frandroid.com/produits/voitures, frandroid.com/survoltes/voitures-electriques/3254001_..., frandroid.com/guide-dachat/...). Each annotated with 'Aucune mention de Toyota sur cette page'. 'Afficher 18 articles de plus' = 28 total matching the card badge count. Prompts section present. Article URLs are specific and match the source's qualifying answers.

results.title: Owned and competitor domains excluded

steps.title: Given a completed analysis where brand-owned domains (toyota.com, toyota.fr, toyota.es) appear in AI Citation Sources
When the Actions Center Target Sources list renders (all 208 sources expanded)
Then brand-owned domains (toyota.com, toyota.fr, toyota.es) do NOT appear in Target Sources list
And key competitor domains (tesla.com, bmw.com, volkswagen.com) do NOT appear in Target Sources list

results.notes: Brand-owned domains confirmed absent: toyota.com, toyota.fr, toyota.es (all appear in AI Citation Sources but correctly excluded from 208-source Target Sources list). tesla.com absent. bmw.com, volkswagen.com, honda.com, hyundai.com, kia.com absent. HOWEVER: stellantis.com (Stellantis corporate — automotive competitor group owning Peugeot, Citroen, Fiat, Opel) IS present at position #145 as type 'Entreprise' with 1 article problematique. Cannot confirm via UI whether stellantis.com is registered as a competitor domain in system config — causal exclusion reason not exposed in UI.

results.title: No cap from AI Citation Sources

steps.title: Given a completed analysis with more domains than the AI Citation Sources display limit cited in qualifying answers
When the Actions Center Target Sources list renders
Then all domains appear in the list (total exceeds the AI Citation Sources display cap of 10)

results.notes: AI Citation Sources section (dashboard overview) displays 10 domains with 'Tous les domaines: 53' total. Target Sources (Actions Center TOUTES tab) shows 208 total sources after expanding 'Afficher 198 sources de plus'. 208 >> 53 AI Citation total and >> 10 display cap. The Actions Center list is not capped at the AI Citation Sources display limit. Confirmed: show-more expanded from 10 visible to 208 fully rendered sources.

results.title: Model-declared URLs excluded at selection

steps.title: Given a completed analysis where at least one answer cites a model-declared URL (non-grounded, from model memory)
When the Actions Center Target Sources list renders
Then no source cited exclusively via model-declared URLs appears in the list (provenance=GROUNDED predicate applied)

results.notes: SKIP — Backend-only verification. The provenance=GROUNDED predicate is applied server-side at selection time. No UI indicator distinguishes grounded vs. model-declared URLs in the Target Sources list or the explanation panel. Verifying this AC requires access to API/backend logs or internal data pipeline — not achievable via UI inspection.
